text:
marta: @edgecloud-tech hey — quick sync on the joint POC telemetry asks. Partner wants: export of inference metrics (latency, model-id, tokens), ability to stream traces into their datadog/splunk, and a cost estimate for telemetry ingestion. They also sent a security questionnaire (SOC2 + KMS questions). Can we outline options + a rough pricing delta for the pilot? :wave:

sam: thanks — they're green on budget for a short pilot. need a 1–2 line ballpark we can put in the SOW. also asked if we can cap egress to avoid surprise fees.

ryan: short answer: yes. options we support today: webhook sink, S3/obj storage export, Datadog/Prometheus remote write, and direct partner pull via signed url. For low-latency streaming use webhook/datadog; for bulk/event replay use S3. For capping you can set a quota on telemetry events per-tenant which will drop or sample beyond threshold. Example prom remote_write snippet they can use to push metrics:```remote_write:
  - url: "https://ingest.redwood.ai/prometheus"
    basic_auth:
      username: "<tenant>"
      password: "<api-key>"
```

anika: engineering notes: dedicated pool for the pilot is feasible but requires a short capacity commit (monthly) and entitlements for telemetry export. We need concrete payload samples — specifically avg event size and fields — to estimate egress and storage. Security Qs: we support TLS 1.2+, mTLS for webhook, and CMK via KMS/HSM in Private deployments. If they need customer-managed keys in Hosted, we can enable via our enterprise add-on (adds 48–72h onboarding). Also toggles to reduce telemetry: prefix caching, downsampled token-level metrics, and event sampling.

edgecloud-tech: thanks. couple follow-ups from our side:
- retention: what's default retention for export vs platform metrics?
- do exported traces include request/response tokens (PII concern)?
- can we get cert rotation docs?
- rough numbers: pilot expected 500 eps (events/sec) at peak, avg event ~1.2KB.

ryan: defaults — platform observability metrics: 30d. Exported telemetry (when shipped to partner) we can retain for 60d in pilot, extendable to 90/365 as an add-on. About tokens: we never export raw prompt text unless you explicitly enable conversational export; the standard metrics/traces are IDs + metadata (latency, model, token_count). If they need sampled request bodies we require a signed agreement and masking rules. Cert rotation: we have a short runbook, will DM link. :thumbsup:

sam: pricing idea for SOW (pilot):
- telemetry add-on: $600/mo flat (includes webhooks + 60d retention)
- ingestion egress: $0.015 per 1k events (first 1M events included)
- dedicated pool: $1,200/mo (min 1 month)
These are placeholders — final quote after payload sample and traffic profile.

edgecloud-tech: that pricing looks fine as a starting point. For the SOC2/Q audit items — can you confirm where we mark data residency and KMS choices? Partner requires EU residency.

anika: EU residency supported via our eu-region private export — we'll enable an EU-only export endpoint. For KMS, Hosted + CMK add-on allowed, or Private deploy with customer KMS in their cloud. We'll add the needed answers to the questionnaire once we see the exact control IDs.

marta: next steps:
- @edgecloud-tech: share sample payloads + expected peak RPS by EOD Wednesday (action: partner)
- @ryan + @anika: prepare a short tech note (1–2 pages) summarizing export options, required entitlements, and cert rotation docs (action: eng) — due Thursday 10am PT
- @sam: I'll draft SOW stub with the pilot pricing placeholders and add a cap clause for telemetry egress (action: sales)
- schedule 60min deep-dive Thurs 11am PT.

sam: sounds good. tagging @ops-runbook-bot to remind us 24h prior. :eyes: 

edgecloud-tech: agreed — will share artefacts. thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
